authority: Management decision A (20 Oct 2026) and the follow-up review of the same day: classify each Must Include point of the 2,026 generic-note questions by its role in that task, not by category. Drafted by engineering (AI-assisted) for methodology-owner review. Nothing here is active.
activation: Per question. A question's classification is applied only when its review_status is APPROVED (set by the methodology owner, with reviewer and date). Every other question keeps today's rule: 5 all points, 3 one missing, two or more missing held as PENDING_APPROVAL (no interim zero).

principle.E: Essential: the point is itself the safety, hygiene, welfare or integrity requirement of this task (e.g. stop / do not touch / isolate before work / do not falsify / verify identity before access). Missing it means the answer does not show safe competence, whatever else is said.
principle.C: Core: a material step of this task. Missing core points lowers the band.
principle.S: Supporting: preparation, courtesy, documentation or elaboration that is not decisive for this task. Assigned per question, never by category: preparation, checks, documentation or consent are E or C wherever the task depends on them.

proposed_scoring_conditions.0_negative: An affirmed negative indicator (unsafe, unauthorized, concealing or falsifying action) scores 0 and is a critical failure, unchanged.
proposed_scoring_conditions.0_essential: Any Essential point missing scores 0 (band ESSENTIAL_MISSING). This is an essential missing requirement, recorded separately from an affirmed unsafe action and not a critical failure.
proposed_scoring_conditions.5: All Essential and all Core points evidenced, answer safe. Supporting points never lower the band.
proposed_scoring_conditions.3: All Essential points evidenced and no more than the question's max_core_missing_for_3 Core points missing (proposed: half the Core points rounded down, at least 1), answer safe.
proposed_scoring_conditions.0_core: More Core points missing than the question's max_core_missing_for_3 (band CORE_OMISSIONS). The basis is the question's own Core list and allowance, shown on each row for review.
proposed_scoring_conditions.0_no_evidence: No Must Include point evidenced: insufficient evidence (SCR-03), unchanged.

combined_point_rule_proposal: A point that names several actions joined by 'and' or commas is evidenced only when each action is evidenced in substance (equivalent or concise wording accepted). Alternatives written with '/' or 'or' need one of them. Points with this pattern are listed in 'combined' for each question. Not yet applied to the interpretation prompt.
